Answer: F
Reason: Although the provided images are prenatal ultrasounds rather than a chest X-ray, they demonstrate a microcystic lung lesion (hyperechogenic mass) with systemic arterial supply (indicated by color Doppler in Figure 2), which is characteristic of a hybrid CCAM/bronchopulmonary sequestration. In the context of the available options describing cystic lung malformations, Option F is the most appropriate choice as it correctly identifies the management for an asymptomatic patient (conservative/postnatal monitoring) and describes small cysts consistent with the microcystic appearance seen on ultrasound, distinguishing it from the large macrocysts of Type I or the solid appearance of Type III.
